summary.text: Tom Brinkman Jr. is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Ashley Bryant Bailey.
He previously served in the Ohio House, representing District 34 from 2001 to 2008 and District 27 from 2015 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Tom Brinkman Jr. earned a B.A. in history and political science from George Washington University in 1979.
His professional experience includes sales work at Curry Printing and Metroweb Corporation, and an internship in the office of former U.S. Senator Robert Dole.

Brinkman chaired the House Insurance Committee in 2019-2020 and 2021-2022, and also served on the Financial Institutions, Federalism and Public Utilities committees in those terms, according to Ballotpedia.
He did not run for re-election to the District 27 seat in 2022.
In 2024 Brinkman was the Republican candidate in the special general election for Hamilton County Auditor and lost to incumbent Jessica Miranda, 55.4 percent to 44.6 percent.
